title: The manufacture of examples: the $(-1)$-classical orthogonal polynomials
summary: The big $(-1)$-Jacobi, Bannai-Ito, and $(-1)$-Meixner-Pollaczek polynomials have appeared in the mathematical physics literature through differential- or difference-reflection eigenvalue problems. We show that these three families are governed by a single alternating mechanism, formulated at the level of orthogonality functionals, transpose operators, and structural identities.
